steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (She's gone?!)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (But she shouldn't have spotted me.)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Perhaps she's got training and keeps her anti-surveillance act up?)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Or is there some place around here she can sneak into without anyone noticing?)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Oh well... I'll go look for Hui-chieh first.)

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: First things first, let's look at which teams made it.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: A total of fifteen teams entered the first round of this competition.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Team LUNG wRATh is definitely this competition's hottest team.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Team Grey Feather, Team Pacer-man, Team Honey Summer, Team Business Cooperation Call 5453-46235...

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Nice work out there, D.D.D.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Sorry you had to take on such an unfamiliar job.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: No prob. I'm used to tooting the big shots' horns.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: I thought I wouldn't be cut out for this, but it turns out it's basically just like DJing.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: It's just one uses music to get the crowd pumped up, while the other uses words.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: It's great that you think that way. If you don't want to do it, though, I'll do everything I can to turn the job down.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: I gotta say, I'm really just going along for the ride. I did kinda think I said some stuff I probably wouldn't have said before, though.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: That was close.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But I really gotta say. You saw how that team LUNG wRATh did.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Those two chicks on the team were amazing.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Oh, I agree.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Just watching the two of them was enough to really give me that creative itch.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Makes me want to write a song for them, y'know?

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: And knowing I can keep watching them fight in the VIP section motivates me to stick with this job, too.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Haha, that's great to hear.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Eh, Missy, I don't get it. The competition's over, and only now are you excited.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You've been strolling around the streets for the past few days, but it doesn't really look like that's all you're doing either. Is there something out here that piques your interest?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm taking a stroll around alright, but I do have another reason.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I want to get to know this city.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How come?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You see, Bolívar is right out there, past the city's borders. A country under three different governments.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The Singas government that's propped up by Leithanien, the Coalition government supported by Columbia, and the True Bolívarians that sprang up to oppose those two governments.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm sure clashes between those three governments, big and small, are happening all across the country while we're just sitting here.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And this city doesn't look like any of the other Bolívarian cities that we stopped at on our way here.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You can't say this one's just prosperous. Even I've never seen a place so extravagant, so totally dedicated to leisure.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't you think it's strange that a city like this popped up in Bolívar?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Well, I do think it's strange, but this isn't Lungmen, and I can't be bothered to look into it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You know, you know everything, but if it's got nothing to do with Lungmen or Ch'en, you never seem to care.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's a force of habit. Go on, Missy. You've got an idea or something, don't you?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: If this city was dark and gloomy, then I certainly wouldn't have felt anything off about it. On the contrary, though, it's so full of energy here that it's irritating.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: If every city out there had a heart, then Lungmen's would probably be a lively one, and its blood would be healthy, and vivid red, always getting pumped to the heart to keep it going.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But Dossoles's heart is way too shady. It keeps on pumping in dirty, black blood, but it doesn't hurt. In fact, it's somehow beating even stronger than our healthy Lungmen.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And that makes the place seem like it's got more pep than Lungmen.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And let's not even go into how Lungmen very rarely finds itself held back by any external forces. This city is in Bolívar, where the political situation couldn't be more messed up.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't you think that's strange?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, that's a good analogy. Really makes it easy to understand.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So you're curious why the city is like this, even when it shouldn't be?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: This city tolerates crime, encourages gambling, and you've got the most voluptuous, spendthrifty kinds here. Each and every day, someone hits it big, while some other poor sod goes bankrupt.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: This creates the illusion that this city's main sources of income are its tourism and entertainment industries—They attract visitors and squeeze the money out of them.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: An entertainment industry by itself can't support all of a city's operations, however. That's why the city leaves its entertainment industry and even crime on the streets unchecked, attracting all kinds of sketchy people.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And that gives the city its false, unstable prosperity.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: There's an explanation.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But is that really how things are?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm... Missy, I kind of think you're overreacting a little.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What did you just say?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It makes sense, though. For a pampered lady like you, the way this city works is uncommon and barbaric.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But it's all pretty near and dear to me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm sure you know that Higashi isn't in a much better shape than Bolívar. In Higashi, even when there's a full-scale war outside, the elites holed up inside couldn't care less.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fundamentally, this city isn't all that different from those cities I know.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, but now that you mention it, it's true that you can't run a city on entertainment and tourism alone.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There aren't any cities like that in Higashi either.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So I guess you should tell me more, Missy. About your discovery.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I don't wanna talk about it anymore.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, come on, Missy. It's all my bad, okay?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Waiter, one raspado de verano, please. For the lady.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Okay, Missy, don't be mad. Cool off with some shaved ice, okay?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph, do you remember what happened when we came to this city?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Didn't we walk right in as soon as you flashed your card?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That's me being well-prepared. Lungmen has a trade agreement with Dossoles, so I could come right in with just my card.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm not talking about myself. I'm talking about the other people that were there.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, I remember seeing a few pretty nervous guys trying to get inside. The guards asked them a few questions, but let them through right after.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The guards were pretty friendly, too. They even gave them directions.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Do you remember seeing a lot of factories outside the city center?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yes, I did.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Bingo.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, I get it. The political situation is ever-changing in Bolívar, so it's dangerous to rely on trade for daily necessities.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So the city had to take fate into its own hands.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And those poor folks are factory workers.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That's right. I asked around at the bar the last couple days. The factories here apparently pay really well.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That's why a lot of people take the arduous journey just to come here to work.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And if they manage to get a good foothold here, that's going to make them a small fortune compared to outside.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Right. It may not make them as much as fighting for the Coalition or Singas, but working here is much safer.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Haha, I'm not sure which is safer, between getting bludgeoned to death in a back alley or dying on the battlefield.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Stop interrupting. After that, I looked up some old news articles. This city may be known all over Bolívar for its entertainment industry, but its wine, coffee, and sugar are the finest in the country too.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: All the Bolívarian elites, whether they are from the Coalition, Singas, or True Bolívarians, are buying them up.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And even outside, I've seen lots of Bolívarian tequila and coffee back home. I don't remember the exact place they were produced, but I've definitely seen these factories' brands before.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The guards are well-equipped and full of energy...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And otherwise, aside from its entertainment and tourism sectors, the city also has a firm grip over a luxury goods industry that no one can ignore.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I get what you mean now. The city may seem chaotic on the surface, but it's actually very stable deep down. It's 100% capable of becoming a proper, methodical city like Lungmen.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Now this is really starting to pique my interest.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And here you said I was overreacting.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I beg your forgiveness, Milady. Your insight is unparalleled. A lowly errand girl like me cannot dare to compare.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That's some glib tongue you got.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Really though, Missy. Speaking from experience, the answer you seek is actually very simple.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No matter what, those who stand on top will never tolerate a variable out of their control.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If this city is managing to keep this appearance up, then that must mean that, to its ruler, what we think is chaotic here is hardly worth batting an eye over.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: In other words, this city has a powerful, crazed mastermind.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That's my conclusion as well.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The mayor is named Candela Sanchez.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: My family participates in some of the business dealings between Lungmen and Dossoles, but I've really never truly understood her or her city until now.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm curious just what kind of a person she is to shape her city this way.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You could talk to her directly. Just tell her who you are. She'll most definitely see you.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'll pass. You can fool others with words, but not with the outcomes of your actions.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Let's go. We still have a lot of places to visit.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I want to take a look at the factories in the countryside. Let's hurry.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Ma'am, your raspado.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, wait, Missy. Your ice just got here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, what do I do with this girl... Sometimes she's just like Ch'en. Always so impatient.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine, I'll eat it myself.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Missy, wait up!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Green hair and a horn... Is that Hoshiguma?)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What are you looking at?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nothing. Just thought I saw an old friend.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: From Lungmen? Where?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There's too many people. She was gone after I looked away for just a second. It's okay. There's no way she'd be here. My eyes are probably playing tricks on me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And what about you? You asked to meet here, and you're late?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I took a detour. Let's go in first.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This isn't that bar you trashed the other day, right?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's my turf now. Come on.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Hey, boss, what brings you here?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Make sure no one comes near us. We'll be talking, alone.

steps.name: Casino Underling
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: A whiskey.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just soda water for me.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Right away.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Go ahead. What is it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I doubt you'd ever invite me out just for drinks.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I tailed a team during the match. They were going all around the residential district, setting up bombs.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And judging from their conversation, there were probably at least three or four teams doing the same.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Didn't you just say...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Oh, so you suspect Ernesto.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You don't?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Well, I see where you're coming from. That's no small operation, and news of it wouldn't have gotten to Lady Candela if it had been just a single smuggling operation.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Someone is definitely manipulating the information somewhere down the line. Ernesto's fairly suspicious, but even if he's in the clear, there's definitely somebody else.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I can't get to the bottom of everything just by myself, though I do have one of the bombs right here in my pocket, at the very least.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Want to give it a squeeze?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll pass.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Which team?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Grey Feather.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Them, huh? Didn't expect that.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It wouldn't have occurred to me either.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Which means they're definitely up to something, and they have a well organized plan.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And since they've got explosives, that's definitely no normal plan.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What are you going to do?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I think we should talk to Lady Candela first.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm sure you've noticed what they are propping up this city's colorful appearance with, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And Lady Candela, the mayor of the city, is allowing all of this to happen under her nose.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Does a city like this, or someone like her, really deserve your help?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm going to fight you again if you tell me you'll let those guys set up bombs just because of that.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Quite the opposite.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I don't really care that much about what this city is like or what's going to happen to it.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm here to represent Chief Wei. What I care about is Chief Wei's image.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That's why I don't really have a choice. I have to complete Lady Candela's request.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But what about you? How do I know you're not standing up against me because of that overflowing sense of justice of yours?
All of a sudden, Ch'en lifts her head and stares straight into Lin Yühsia's eyes.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you trying to say?
Lin Yühsia isn't backing down either. She, too, is staring straight at Ch'en.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What I'm saying, Hui-chieh, is that you should stop faking all those emotions you have for people you've never even met.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You have no right to get involved with anything that has to do with the city, and you definitely have no right to blame me for anything.

a.text: A thunderous 'pop,' that of a fist and a palm clashing together, rings through the quiet bar.
Ch'en's fist is about an inch away from Lin Yühsia's face, held firmly back only by Lin Yühsia's palm.
Their faces are still as water, leaving only their fierce stares to reveal their convictions.

Standing not far away from them, the casino boss sees a shapeless fire burning amidst their silence. The flame is raging and growing more intense by the second, as though it could engulf everything in their vicinity at any moment.
Right away, he starts to work out how much he will spend renovating his casino, as well as which contractor in the neighborhood charges the least.
However, contrary to his expectations, the flame does not erupt into a volcano of rage.
After another brief moment of silence, Ch'en retracts her fist, and Lin Yühsia lowers her hand.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This won't help you absolve yourself.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And I'm not trying to absolve myself.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: One day, I will make sure you pay for all that you've done.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And how will you make me do that, Lungmen Special Inspection Unit Chief Emeritus, Miss Ch'en Hui-chieh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: With righteousness.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Well, at least that has a slightly better ring to it than justice. If that day ever comes, I will be ready and accept my punishment.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Anything else?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That's it. You can do whatever you want to do, and I will do things my way. That's what I'm trying to tell you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The fewer people who know about this, the better, but we should at least let Lady Candela know, no matter how we go about this.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Even if you tell her, there isn't all that much she can do.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We still don't know what their objective is. Trying to scope them out or arrest them is just going to startle them.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Also, don't use your phone.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't need you to tell me that.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Oh, right. I forgot how much you cops love your wiretaps.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You really want a fight, don't you?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I haven't the interest.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Well, you've made up your mind. Go talk to Lady Candela, then. I've got better things to do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I never thought the day would come for us to work together...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Likewise.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: You don't have a big enough fist, and what are you standing up straight like that for...?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Shop's closed today.
I'd like a fincatching rod.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Come in.
Hermano, can't you stop changing the password every day? It's a chore to get them down.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Rafaela, stop letting your guard down. Do you know how hard it was for me to disguise your mistake as some normal weapons smuggling?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If Ms. Candela manages to sniff us out, we're done for.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If you're doing this, see it through.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: *Sigh*... Fine.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I'm not trying to yell at you, Rafaela. You're a klutz, but you do a decent job with everything you need to do.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: It's the idiots who don't know the gravity of all this.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: This city is full of entertainment, but if that's all the city has, there's no way it could've gotten such a foothold in Bolívar.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: But you still called me a klutz...

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But, my lovely sister, you are a klutz, no?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Actually, I got the feeling that I was being followed just now.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: I'm not sure, but that's what it felt like.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I'll let everyone in the competitions know to be careful.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Never mind... I guess that, outside of the mission, these guys aren't all that different from the folks who live here. You wouldn't be able to get much out of them.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Anyway, how did the mission go?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: We got the bombs installed in the residential district.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Did anyone find you?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: I ran into the purple-haired girl on your team about halfway through. I avoided a direct confrontation with her, like you'd told me.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And what did she do?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: She didn't bother us.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: She didn't come to me about it. I guess she really didn't notice...

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: No, there's no guarantee that's the case. She's clearly mistrustful of me, even more so than Ch'en. It's possible that she found out but chose to hide it from me.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And even if she found out, there's probably very little she could do...

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: *Sigh*, they don't want to work together, and I can't keep an eye on both of them at once. What a pain.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Your orders?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If the mayor starts investigating the competition area, let my father know right away.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Phew, I guess this will do for now.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I've taken a look at which teams made it through. Out of the forty teams in the competition, twelve are on our side, and nine of those made it through. It's more or less what I expected.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Yeah, if it wasn't for the blue haired girl getting in the way, we probably could've taken down another team or two.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: It was never all that reliable of a plan, luring out teams with pure gold out in the open and then taking them down, so there's really nothing to complain about with these results.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: We made it through the first round. All we have to do during the second round is get in the other teams' way.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: After all, the second round's full of Ms. Candela's underlings hiding in every corner to ambush anyone who tries to take a shortcut. It's not the right time to set up more bombs.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And the less teams at the end of the second round, the better. That's our goal in this round. You remember that, right?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Stop taking me for a dummy.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I'm just telling you again, just in case.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Right, since you're here, I might as well tell you now. There's a change in plans.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: What's wrong? Are those outsiders that tough?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Yeah, they're probably a little too tough, even.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Should we take them out?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: First, we'd probably pay a dear price for that.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And secondly... They are good people.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Good people?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's right. Good people.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If I'd known them longer, I'd even try to persuade them to join our cause.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Would they join us?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: No idea, but it's not happening now.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's why I can only assume the old man will be in danger if they get close to him on the ship. We'll need to do all we can to stall them.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But to get to the point, I probably won't be on the ship, so I'll probably try to work with you on land.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Will you need my help?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If it comes down to it, I will. That's why I'm telling you this now.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Let's move on to something less serious.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That reminds me, Rafaela. You've lived in this city for a few years now. Do you know where the name Dossoles came from?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Hm? I haven't really heard why... But I'm guessing it has to do with why they call this the City of Two Suns.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's right. Now take another guess. Which two suns?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Hm... The one on the sky?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: This one's too obvious. You can see it just by looking up.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: And the second one... is the one you see in the water?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Very good. I thought you wouldn't figure it out.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The city's ocean completely engulfs the sun in the sky.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Papa told me about that before.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Now, do you know that this city was almost renamed Tressoles, the City of Three Suns?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Huh? Three suns?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's right. Now what do you think the third sun is?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: The third sun...?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Maybe the mayor?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Hahaha, that's one theory. Ms. Candela is like the city's sun, and this city only exists because of her.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's not the right answer, though.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Huh? It's not?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The mayor is a prideful person, but she wouldn't compare herself with the sun. Her pride is above even the sun.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: She wouldn't put herself on the same level as two other suns. She would say all three suns are hers.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Then what's the third sun?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The answer's simple. It's on your papa's boat.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: He's your papa... He's my step-dad. Eh, is it the pretty gold statue?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Haha, that's right. That's the city's third sun.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Supposedly, it took everyone quite a while to persuade Ms. Candela not to go there.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: That sounds kinda lame.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Is there anything that isn't lame about this city?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: It looks like you enjoy living here though.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Do I look like I enjoy this place?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: You don't?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: I kind of think you've been enjoying working for the mayor the last few years.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If that's the case, why would I help Father?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: No idea. I've always thought you weren't going to.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: *Sigh*... Your intuition is always so on point.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: And here you just called me a klutz.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Hahaha...

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Anyway, let's get back to preparing for the match.
